parameters.content:
W02 Lead Ads webhook (leadgen). Verify X-Hub-Signature-256 over the raw body -> 200 immediately -> fetch lead via Graph (retry x3 in meta-ads.js) -> idempotency on leadgen_id -> backstop qualification (bands + consent; form conditional logic is not trusted) -> same path as W01 via the sub-workflow "W01 Lead core": dedupe 90 d, Twilio line-type, route to broker, store, CAPI Lead, first WhatsApp < 60 s. Out-of-band / no-consent leads are NOT stored and never enter the automation (2.1.7); only an anonymous counter row is written. CONTRACT ASSUMPTION: automation/tests/W01.test.mjs does not exist yet; payload below follows crm-gap leads columns and must be reconciled by automation-engineer. Needs env META_APP_SECRET, META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN, META_SYSTEM_USER_TOKEN.

Page ingress (I-16/I-25): this callback is the Meta `page` object. leadgen changes take the path above; `feed` comments are forwarded to W30 and Messenger DMs to W31 (Execute Workflow, no wait) with the raw body (base64 of the received bytes) and the original X-Hub-Signature-256, so they verify it themselves.

parameters.query:
-- physical column, full unique index leads_leadgen_full_uidx (06). The insert itself is W01's: it must use INSERT INTO public.leads (leadgen_id, ...) ... ON CONFLICT (leadgen_id) DO NOTHING, so a webhook re-delivery racing this check still stores one lead.
SELECT id FROM public.leads WHERE leadgen_id = $1 LIMIT 1;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO ops.notifications (kind, "to", channel, severity, status, source, dedupe_key, what, body)
SELECT 'lead_routed_out', 'console', 'console', 'info', 'sent', 'W02', $1::text, 'Lead Ad lead routed out (not qualified)', jsonb_build_object('ad_id', $2::text)
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.notifications n WHERE n.dedupe_key = $1::text AND n.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours')
RETURNING 1; -- anonymous: ad id only, reasons stay in the execution data and the lead is not stored (2.1.7).
